The imaging facts in this document are two: the diagnostic radiology row and the outpatient x-ray row.

The diagnostic radiology row reads "such as CT/CAT scan and MRI", which is not an exact list of the services it covers. I therefore state it as `imaging.diagnostic` (diagnostic radiology other than X-rays), in the any-setting category. The row is not limited to CT and MRI, so I did not use `imaging.diagnostic.advanced`.

The page 3 "Diagnostic tests and procedures" row is not an imaging benefit in the list, so I left it out. The dental x-rays are a supplemental dental benefit, not outpatient X-rays, so I also left them out.
